plugins.name: Mistral Vibe
plugins.description: Adds a Mistral provider to CLIProxyAPI through the Vibe (console.mistral.ai) browser OAuth sign-in, so inference draws on the subscription's Vibe Code allowance instead of a pay-as-you-go API key. Browser login stored as a CPA credential, native model discovery from the Mistral /v1/models API, and a Quota Management card showing the monthly Vibe Code and API allowances. Inference runs on CPA's built-in OpenAI-compatible executor via the credential's base_url and api_key attributes.
plugins.author: duchm1606
